name: Land Surveying Operations
audience: small land-surveying firms coordinating field crews and office deliverables
topic: field-crew readiness and survey deliverable release

products.name: Survey Field Readiness
products.product: A focused land survey field crew readiness workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: small land-surveying firms coordinating field crews and office deliverables
products.problem: A crew leaves without the current scope, parcel research, deeds, control, access permission, utility or hazard notes, equipment, coordinate files, monument history, or client timing constraints.
products.valueProposition: Turns land survey field crew readiness into a visible operating queue so every survey field assignment has current office research, site permissions, technical files, equipment, crew capability, and explicit release.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets land survey crew scheduling, survey field packet, land surveying project software, and survey job checklist searches.

products.name: Survey Deliverable Release
products.product: A focused land survey deliverable quality review workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: small land-surveying firms coordinating field crews and office deliverables
products.problem: Field files, calculations, CAD revisions, monument notes, legal descriptions, exhibits, certifications, client comments, and invoice milestones can move independently before final delivery.
products.valueProposition: Turns land survey deliverable quality review into a visible operating queue so every survey deliverable is traceable to current field and office inputs, passes the firm's required professional review, and is delivered as a controlled version.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets land survey quality control, survey deliverable checklist, survey project tracking, and survey review workflow searches.
